description: React component for managing custom data retention policies in Mattermost admin console, including UI for policy name, retention settings, and associated teams/channels.

classes.name: CustomPolicyForm
classes.description: React component class for creating and editing custom data retention policies, with state management for form inputs, selected teams/channels, and submission handling.

methods.name: openAddChannel
methods.description: Opens the modal to add channels.

methods.name: closeAddChannel
methods.description: Closes the modal for adding channels.

methods.name: openAddTeam
methods.description: Opens the modal to add teams.

methods.name: closeAddTeam
methods.description: Closes the modal for adding teams.

methods.name: getMessageRetentionDefaultInputValue
methods.description: Returns default input value for message retention based on current policy.

methods.name: getMessageRetentionDefaultDropdownValue
methods.description: Returns default dropdown value for message retention based on current policy.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Fetches policy data and initializes form state.

methods.name: addToNewTeams
methods.description: Adds selected teams to the newTeams state, removing them from removedTeams if necessary.

methods.name: addToRemovedTeams
methods.description: Marks a team as removed from the policy.

methods.name: addToNewChannels
methods.description: Adds selected channels to the newChannels state, removing them from removedChannels if necessary.

methods.name: addToRemovedChannels
methods.description: Marks a channel as removed from the policy.

methods.name: getTeamsToExclude
methods.description: Returns list of team IDs to exclude when selecting channels.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a data retention policy.
